<style>
html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  background: #f8f9fa;
  /* Hide scrollbar but keep scroll functionality */
  scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
  -ms-overflow-style: none; /* Internet Explorer 10+ */
}

/* Hide scrollbar for Chrome, Safari and Opera */
body::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

/* Top Navigation Bar */
.navbar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 70px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00cfff 0%, #00b8e6 100%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 20px;
  z-index: 999;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.navbar-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.navbar-left img {
  height: 2.5vw;
  width: auto;
  min-height: 30px;
}

.navbar-title {
  color: white;
  font-size: 18px; /* changed from 1.2vw */
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.navbar-links {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2vw;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Hamburger Menu Styles */
.hamburger {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 10px;
  z-index: 1001;
}

.hamburger span {
  width: 25px;
  height: 3px;
  background: white;
  margin: 3px 0;
  transition: 0.3s;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
  transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(-5px, 6px);
}

.hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
}

.hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
  transform: rotate(45deg) translate(-5px, -6px);
}

/* Mobile Menu Overlay */
.mobile-menu {
  position: fixed;
  top: 70px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00cfff 0%, #00b8e6 100%);
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  z-index: 1000;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.mobile-menu.active {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.mobile-menu a {
  display: block;
  padding: 20px;
  color: white;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.mobile-menu a:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.mobile-menu a:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .navbar-links {
    gap: 20px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .navbar-links {
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .navbar a {
    padding: 22px 20px;
    font-size: 15px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .navbar-links {
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .navbar a {
    padding: 22px 16px;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
}

/* Force hamburger to show on mobile - AGGRESSIVE APPROACH */
@media screen and (max-width: 800px) {
  .navbar {
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  
  .navbar-links {
    display: none;
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  
.hamburger {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00cfff 0%, #00b8e6 100%) !important; /* Match tab bar */
  border: 3px solid white !important; /* White border instead of yellow */
  border-radius: 6px;
}
  
  .hamburger span {
    background: white !important;
    background-color: white !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    display: block !important;
  }
  
  .navbar-title {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

    height: 35px;
  }
}

@media screen and (max-width: 800px) {
  .hamburger {
    display: flex !important;

    opacity: 1 !important;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00cfff 0%, #00b8e6 100%) !important;
    border: 3px solid white !important;
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);

/* Image Comparison Slider Styles */
.image-comparison {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 30px 0;
}

.comparison-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 400px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 15px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  cursor: grab;
  user-select: none;
}

.comparison-container:active {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.before-image, .after-image {
  position: relative;
  width: 400px;
  height: auto;
}

.before-image img, .after-image img {
  width: 400px;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

.after-image {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 400px;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 0);
  z-index: 2; /* Put the after image above the labels */
}

.image-label {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  color: white;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  text-shadow: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.before-label {
  right: 20px;
  background: rgba(0, 207, 255, 1);
  z-index: 1; /* Put it below the after image */
}

.after-label {
  left: 20px;
  background: rgba(0, 207, 255, 1);
  z-index: 1; /* Put it below the after image */
}

.slider-handle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 50%;
  width: 4px;
  height: 100%;
  background: white;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 3;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.slider-line {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, 
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 0%, 
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) 50%, 
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) 100%);
}

.slider-button {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  background: #00cfff;
  border: 3px solid white;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.slider-button:hover {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.2);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 207, 255, 0.6);
}

/* Remove the arrow styles - delete these completely */
.slider-arrow {
  display: none;
}

.slider-arrow.left {
  display: none;
}

.slider-arrow.right {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .comparison-container {
    width: calc(100vw - 60px);

    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  
  .before-image, .after-image {
    width: calc(100vw - 60px);

  }
  
  .before-image img, .after-image img {
    width: calc(100vw - 60px);
    max-width: 400px;
    height: auto;
  }

  }

.carousel-container {
  position: relative;

}

.carousel-item {

}

  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  z-index: 1;
}

.carousel-navigation {

}

<div class="section" id="what">
<h2>What We Do</h2>
<p>We take care of your apartment cleaning checks for you. Whether it's scrubbing the bathroom, vacuuming the carpet, or wiping down counters—we do it all so you don't get fined or fail your check. Our professional team ensures your space meets all inspection requirements while you focus on what matters most to you.</p>
</div>

<div class="section" id="how">
  <h2>How It Works</h2>
  <p>
    Booking with us is simple and stress-free. Just schedule an appointment online or by phone, provide your address and preferred time, and our experienced team will take care of the rest. All appointments must be booked at least <strong>1 day in advance</strong> to ensure proper scheduling and preparation.
    <br><br>

    On the day of your cleaning, we ask that <strong>at least one roommate is present</strong> during the appointment. This ensures a smooth handoff, allows access to the apartment, and provides mutual protection against any potential disputes or false claims.
    <br><br>

    We bring all necessary cleaning supplies and ensure your space is thoroughly cleaned and <strong>inspection-ready</strong> according to typical student housing standards.
    <br><br>

    <strong>Customer Satisfaction Guarantee:</strong> If our cleaning does not pass inspection, we will provide a <strong>full refund</strong>, including reimbursement for any cleaning-related fees or fines you incur as a result. We stand behind the quality of our work.
    <br><br>

    <strong>Discounts & Deals:</strong><br>
    • <strong>Bulk Deals:</strong> Discounts for multiple rooms or apartments cleaned at once<br>
    • <strong>Time-Based Discounts:</strong> Book 10 or more days in advance and get 10% off<br>
    • <strong>Subscription Discount:</strong> Sign up for monthly cleanings and receive a discounted rate<br><br>

    Our mission is to help you pass your cleaning checks with zero hassle. Fast, affordable, and fully guaranteed.
  </p>
</div>

<script>
// Replace your entire <script> section with this:

// Hamburger menu functionality
const hamburger = document.querySelector('.hamburger');
const mobileMenu = document.querySelector('.mobile-menu');

hamburger.addEventListener('click', function() {
    hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
    mobileMenu.classList.toggle('active');
});

// Close mobile menu when clicking on a link
document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
        hamburger.classList.remove('active');
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('active');
    });
});

// Close mobile menu when clicking outside
document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
    if (!hamburger.contains(event.target) && !mobileMenu.contains(event.target)) {
        hamburger.classList.remove('active');
        mobileMenu.classList.remove('active');
    }
});

// Smooth scrolling for navigation links with custom offsets
document.querySelectorAll('.navbar a, .mobile-menu a').forEach(anchor => {
    anchor.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const targetId = this.getAttribute('href');
        const targetSection = document.querySelector(targetId);
        
        if (targetSection) {
            // Custom offsets for each section
            const offsets = {
                '#what': 120,        // Main section
                '#how': 150,         // How It Works
                '#pricing': 230,     // Pricing
                '#testimonials': 310, // Testimonials
                '#book': 90          // Book Now
            };
            
            // Get custom offset or use default
            const customOffset = offsets[targetId] || 120;
            const offsetTop = targetSection.offsetTop - customOffset;
            
            window.scrollTo({
                top: offsetTop,
                behavior: 'smooth'
            });
        }
    });
});

// Add subtle parallax effect
window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    const scrolled = window.pageYOffset;
    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.section');
    
    sections.forEach(section => {
        const rate = scrolled * -0.1;
        section.style.transform = `translateY(${rate}px)`;
    });
});

// Copy email functionality
document.querySelector('.copy-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const email = 'cleaningchecksandcrap@gmail.com';
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(email).then(function() {
        const btn = document.querySelector('.copy-btn');
        const originalText = btn.textContent;
        const originalBackground = btn.style.background;
        const originalColor = btn.style.color;

        btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
        btn.style.background = 'rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.8)';
        btn.style.color = 'white';

        setTimeout(function() {
            btn.textContent = originalText;
            btn.style.background = originalBackground;
            btn.style.color = originalColor;
        }, 2000);
    });
});

let currentSlideIndex = 1;
let isTransitioning = false; // Prevent rapid clicking during transitions

function showSlide(n) {
  if (isTransitioning) return;
  
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-item');
  const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.dot');
  const carousel = document.querySelector('.carousel-container');
  
  if (n > slides.length) {
    currentSlideIndex = 1;
  }
  if (n < 1) {
    currentSlideIndex = slides.length;
  }
  
  isTransitioning = true;
  
  // Calculate and set fixed height before transition to prevent jumping
  const currentActiveSlide = document.querySelector('.carousel-item.active');
  if (currentActiveSlide) {
    const currentHeight = currentActiveSlide.offsetHeight;
    carousel.style.height = currentHeight + 'px';
  }
  
  // Remove active from all slides and dots
  slides.forEach(slide => {
    slide.classList.remove('active');
  });
  
  dots.forEach(dot => {
    dot.classList.remove('active');
  });
  
  // Show new slide immediately (without delay)
  if (slides[currentSlideIndex - 1]) {
    slides[currentSlideIndex - 1].classList.add('active');
  }
  if (dots[currentSlideIndex - 1]) {
    dots[currentSlideIndex - 1].classList.add('active');
  }
  
  // After transition, reset height to auto and reinitialize image comparison
  setTimeout(() => {
    carousel.style.height = 'auto';
    initializeImageComparison();
    isTransitioning = false;
  }, 500); // Match the CSS transition duration
}

// Add this helper function after showSlide:
function setCarouselHeight() {
  const carousel = document.querySelector('.carousel-container');
  const activeSlide = document.querySelector('.carousel-item.active');
  
  if (activeSlide && carousel) {
    // Temporarily set height to auto to get natural height
    carousel.style.height = 'auto';
    const naturalHeight = activeSlide.offsetHeight;
    
    // Set minimum height to prevent content jumping
    carousel.style.minHeight = Math.max(naturalHeight, 400) + 'px';
  }
}

function changeSlide(n) {
  if (isTransitioning) return;
  currentSlideIndex += n;
  showSlide(currentSlideIndex);
}

function currentSlide(n) {
  if (isTransitioning) return;
  currentSlideIndex = n;
  showSlide(currentSlideIndex);
}

// Function to reinitialize image comparison for active slide
function initializeImageComparison() {
  const activeSlide = document.querySelector('.carousel-item.active');
  if (!activeSlide) return;
  
  const comparisonContainer = activeSlide.querySelector('.comparison-container');
  const afterImage = activeSlide.querySelector('.after-image');
  const sliderHandle = activeSlide.querySelector('.slider-handle');
  
  if (!comparisonContainer || !afterImage || !sliderHandle) return;
  
  // Remove existing event listeners by cloning and replacing elements
  const newContainer = comparisonContainer.cloneNode(true);
  comparisonContainer.parentNode.replaceChild(newContainer, comparisonContainer);
  
  // Re-add event listeners to the new container
  setupImageComparisonEvents(newContainer);
}

function setupImageComparisonEvents(container) {
  const afterImage = container.querySelector('.after-image');
  const sliderHandle = container.querySelector('.slider-handle');
  let isDragging = false;
  
  function updateSlider(clientX) {
    const containerRect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const containerWidth = containerRect.width;
    let position = ((clientX - containerRect.left) / containerWidth) * 100;
    
    position = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, position));
    
    const image = afterImage.querySelector('img');
    const imageWidth = image.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    const imagePosition = (position / 100) * containerWidth;
    const clipPosition = 100 - ((imagePosition / imageWidth) * 100);
    
    afterImage.style.clipPath = `inset(0 ${clipPosition}% 0 0)`;
    sliderHandle.style.left = position + '%';
  }
  
  // Mouse events
  container.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
    isDragging = true;
    updateSlider(e.clientX);
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
    if (isDragging) {
      updateSlider(e.clientX);
    }
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
    isDragging = false;
  });
  
  // Touch events
  container.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
    isDragging = true;
    updateSlider(e.touches[0].clientX);
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
    if (isDragging) {
      updateSlider(e.touches[0].clientX);
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  });
  
  document.addEventListener('touchend', function() {
    isDragging = false;
  });
  
  container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!isDragging) {
      updateSlider(e.clientX);
    }
  });
}

// Initialize on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  showSlide(currentSlideIndex);
  setCarouselHeight();
  
  // Recalculate height on window resize
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    setTimeout(setCarouselHeight, 100);
  });
});

</script>
